nodes.name: FastKYC – API-Driven Identity Verification Platform

nodes.name: WALANE – Unified Customer Engagement

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: WALANE is a customer engagement and messaging platform designed to unify outreach, response handling, and campaign execution into a single ecosystem built on the world’s most widely used communication channels.

nodes.name: Breathalyzer Platform – Digital Safety & Compliance Solution

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: Explore how Pentafox helped aviation and ground operations teams replace paper-based alcohol testing with a centralized digital system—improving accuracy, audit readiness, role-based visibility, and regulatory compliance while reducing manual effort and reporting delays.

nodes.name: CoreOps – Unified Flight Operations Platform

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: Explore how Pentafox unified fragmented airline operational data—including flight schedules, crew rosters, pilot attendance, and dispatch workflows—into a single centralized platform, enabling real-time operational visibility, role-based access for operations teams, reduced manual coordination, and audit-ready reporting to improve control, efficiency, and decision-making across airline operations.

nodes.name: Enroute – Digital Travel Desk & Cab Management Platform

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: Explore how Pentafox helped airline operations teams replace manual calls, spreadsheets, and fragmented coordination with a centralized crew transportation platform—automating cab bookings, notifications, and journey tracking, improving real-time visibility for drivers and crew, and significantly reducing manual effort while ensuring reliable and timely crew movement across operations.

nodes.name: In-Flight Service (IFS) – Digital Sales & Operations Platform

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: Explore how Pentafox helped airlines replace manual, paper-based in-flight sales and inventory tracking with an offline-capable digital platform—enabling cabin crew to record transactions reliably across multiple flight legs, synchronizing data securely, reducing payment and stock discrepancies, and providing centralized, real-time visibility and reporting for operational and management teams.

nodes.name: Pricing Portal – Centralised Fare & Revenue Management Platform

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: Explore how Pentafox helped airline pricing teams replace manual, Excel-based fare analysis with a centralized and automated pricing platform—consolidating competitor and internal fare data, applying rule-based pricing logic, generating intelligent fare recommendations, and accelerating data-driven pricing decisions while reducing errors and manpower dependency.

nodes.name: PRS – Passenger Reconciliation System

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: Explore how Pentafox helped airlines replace manual boarding and reconciliation processes with a robust web and mobile platform—enabling fast boarding through parallel scanning, reliable offline operations at gates and ramp areas, real-time passenger status updates, and centralized monitoring to reduce delays, eliminate errors, and improve operational control.

nodes.name: RedCap – Flight Operations Logging & Communication Platform

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: Explore how Pentafox unified fragmented flight operations data into a single digital platform—centralizing flight logs, delays, and ground handling records, automating WhatsApp notifications, standardizing operational reporting, and delivering real-time visibility to ground teams, operations staff, and management to improve coordination, accuracy, and regulatory compliance across airline operations.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Ecom – Conversational Commerce Platform

detailedDescription.detailedDescription: WhatsApp Ecom is a chat-driven e-commerce platform that enables businesses to sell, communicate, and manage orders entirely within WhatsApp, eliminating the need for separate apps or websites.

nodes.name: DICGC – Centralised Premium Computation & Filing Platform

nodes.name: WhatsApp Meal Booking System — Meal Booking via WhatsApp Bot

projectDescription.projectDescription: The WhatsApp Meal Booking System lets airlines offer passengers an easy way to add meals after booking through automated WhatsApp messages. Using a chatbot or a simple web link, passengers can quickly select meals on a familiar platform, making the process fast and convenient.

nodes.name: AMS — Ground Operations Asset Management System

It replaces manual tracking with real-time visibility, improving compliance, control, and operational efficiency.

nodes.name: DCS — Guest Bridge Application-Passenger Contact & Booking Data Integration

projectDescription.projectDescription: Guest Bridge is a supporting application that connects with airline booking systems to retrieve passenger contact details using PNR data and make them available alongside the DCS. It closes communication gaps without changing core DCS functionality, enabling teams to reach passengers quickly and efficiently.

nodes.name: Procure360 — Purchase Request, Approval & Purchase Order Management Platform

It replaces email and Excel-based processes with a controlled, auditable system that improves transparency, efficiency, and compliance.
